snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on Feb 5, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/dragon-quest-vii-reimagined-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Fix the past, save the present!

Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world in Dragon Quest VII Reimagined.

Pre-order today and receive a costume for the Hero along with some helpful items for your journey!
 
#DQ7R #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
